reason: Give the staff-augmentation offer a margin floor. The 32 talent-assurance-staffing policies carried a historical markup with minimum margin 0, so the quoter never flagged a low price. CEO decisions of 2026-10-11: floor 25%, and targets by workbook tier (30/30/35/40%) as proposed by the agent and confirmed by him. Managed-service policies are untouched.

record.note: Person sold by dedication (staff augmentation). Floor 25% of margin on all costs and target 35%: decided by the CEO on 2026-10-11. He set the floor ('25% está bien como piso y de ahí en adelante subimos dependiendo') and confirmed the targets by workbook tier that the agent had proposed (30% tiers 1 and 2, 35% tier 3, 40% tier 4); they replace the historical markup. Applying it to an engagement remains a per-case review, not an approved price.
